result.description: A fictional portable environmental data recorder designed for field researchers, survey teams, and classroom expeditions. Orchid Harbor Field Recorder 12 combines a rugged handheld enclosure with multi-sensor logging for temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and light levels. It includes a 12-channel logging profile, USB-C charging, onboard timestamping, and a simple monochrome display for low-power operation. The unit stores up to 64 GB of log data on internal flash memory and is intended for long-duration outdoor use rather than consumer entertainment or high-performance computing.
